- Recommended intervention: offer a pro-bono upgrade to the Enterprise Plan for the remainder of the term, and if accepted, set a 1-year renewal target at a discounted $7,500/month [NL-026#NL-026-S05].
- Risk is specific to their decentralized retail network and not generalizable to the broader Growth Plan segment [NL-026#NL-026-S02].
